words.sanskrit: atha janakah ha vaidehah yajnavalkyam upasametya uvacha

meaning.en: then Janaka of Videha approached Yajnavalkya and said
meaning.hi: तब विदेह के जनक याज्ञवल्क्य के पास जाकर बोले

words.sanskrit: bhagavan sannyasam anubruhi iti katham sannyasa-lakshanam

meaning.en: Master, explain renunciation to me; what marks a true renunciant
meaning.hi: हे गुरुवर, संन्यास समझाइए; सच्चे संन्यासी का लक्षण क्या है

words.sanskrit: sah ha uvacha yajnavalkyah brahmacharyam samapya grihi bhavet

meaning.en: Yajnavalkya replied: completing disciplined study, one becomes a householder
meaning.hi: याज्ञवल्क्य ने उत्तर दिया: अध्ययन पूरा कर गृहस्थ बने

words.sanskrit: grihat vani bhutva pravrajet

meaning.en: from householder life, becoming a forest-dweller, one proceeds to renunciation
meaning.hi: गृहस्थ जीवन से वनवासी बनकर संन्यास की ओर बढ़े

words.sanskrit: yadi va itaratha brahmacharyat eva pravrajet grihat va vanat va

meaning.en: or, differently, one may renounce directly from studentship, household, or forest
meaning.hi: या, अन्यथा, सीधे छात्र-जीवन, गृहस्थ या वन से संन्यास ले

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha punarvrati va avrati va snatako va asnatako va

meaning.en: whether one has kept every vow or fallen short, completed study or not
meaning.hi: चाहे हर प्रतिज्ञा निभाई हो या चूका हो, अध्ययन पूरा किया हो या नहीं

words.sanskrit: utsanna-agnih anagnokah va

meaning.en: whether the household fire has been kept or let go out
meaning.hi: चाहे गृहस्थ अग्नि बनाए रखी हो या बुझने दी हो

words.sanskrit: yat ahah eva virajet tat ahah eva pravrajet

meaning.en: on whatever day detachment arises, that very day one may renounce
meaning.hi: जिस दिन वैराग्य उदित हो, उसी दिन संन्यास ले सकता है

words.sanskrit: tat eke prajapatyam eva ishtim kurvanti

meaning.en: some perform the Prajapatya offering to mark this
meaning.hi: कुछ इसे चिह्नित करने के लिए प्राजापत्य आहुति करते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha va na kuryat agneyyam eva kuryat

meaning.en: if unable to perform the fire offerings, one should offer to fire itself
meaning.hi: अग्नि-आहुतियाँ न कर सके तो स्वयं अग्नि को आहुति दे

words.sanskrit: agnih hi pranah pranam eva etaya karoti

meaning.en: fire and the breath of life are one; the offering reaches breath through fire
meaning.hi: अग्नि और प्राण एक हैं; आहुति अग्नि के माध्यम से प्राण तक पहुँचती है

words.sanskrit: traidhataviyam eva kuryat

meaning.en: he should also perform an offering connected to the three basic qualities
meaning.hi: उसे तीन बुनियादी गुणों से जुड़ी आहुति भी देनी चाहिए

words.sanskrit: etaya eva trayo dhatavah yat uta sattvam rajah tamah iti

meaning.en: for from these three, clarity, activity, and inertia, fire itself has its origin
meaning.hi: क्योंकि इन तीन, सत्त्व, रज, तम से, स्वयं अग्नि का उद्गम है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tam jnan agnim arohat athano vardhaya rayim iti

meaning.en: understanding this, he offers a mantra as fire is asked to rise and nurture wellbeing
meaning.hi: इसे समझते हुए, अग्नि से ऊपर उठने और कल्याण के पोषण का मंत्र देता है

words.sanskrit: eshah va agneh yonih yah pranam gachchha svam yonim gachchha svaha iti

meaning.en: this is fire's true origin: go to your source, go to your own dwelling, so be it
meaning.hi: यह अग्नि का सच्चा उद्गम है: अपने स्रोत, अपने निवास की ओर जाओ, ऐसा ही हो

words.sanskrit: yat agnim na vindet apsu juhuyat apah vai sarvah devatah

meaning.en: if no fire is found, pour the offering into water, since water represents every divinity
meaning.hi: अग्नि न मिले तो आहुति जल में डाले, क्योंकि जल हर दिव्यता का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है

words.sanskrit: sarvabhyah devatabhyah juhomi svaha iti sajyam havih anamayam

meaning.en: I offer this to all divinities together, so be it; the offering remains whole
meaning.hi: मैं यह सभी दिव्यताओं को अर्पित करता हूँ, ऐसा ही हो; आहुति अक्षत रहती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: moksha-mantrah trayi evam veda tat brahma tat upasitavyam

meaning.en: the liberating mantra, drawn from the three, is Brahman and should be meditated on as such
meaning.hi: तीनों से लिया मुक्तिदायक मंत्र ब्रह्म है और उसी रूप में ध्याया जाए

words.sanskrit: shikham yajnopavitam chhittva sannyastam maya iti trivaram uchcharet

meaning.en: cutting the tuft and thread, one declares three times: I have renounced
meaning.hi: शिखा-सूत्र काटकर तीन बार घोषित करे: मैंने संन्यास ले लिया है

words.sanskrit: evam eva etat bhagavan iti vai yajnavalkyah

meaning.en: this, and just this, is exactly how it is, said Yajnavalkya
meaning.hi: यही, बस यही है, याज्ञवल्क्य ने कहा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha hainam atrih papraccha yajnavalkyam

meaning.en: then Atri asked Yajnavalkya
meaning.hi: तब अत्रि ने याज्ञवल्क्य से पूछा

words.sanskrit: yajnopaviti katham brahmanah iti

meaning.en: what makes one a true wearer of the sacred thread, a genuine Brahmin
meaning.hi: यज्ञोपवीत का सच्चा धारक, असली ब्राह्मण, क्या बनाता है

words.sanskrit: idam pranavam eva asya tat yajnopavitam

meaning.en: this very syllable Om is the true sacred thread
meaning.hi: यह ॐ अक्षर ही सच्चा यज्ञोपवीत है

words.sanskrit: yah atma

meaning.en: which is the self
meaning.hi: जो आत्मा है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: prashya achamya ayam vidhih

meaning.en: after eating only what is begged, this is the proper procedure
meaning.hi: केवल भिक्षा में मिला खाकर, यह उचित विधि है

words.sanskrit: parivrat vivarna-vasah mundah aparigrahah shuchih adrohi bhaikshamanah

meaning.en: the wanderer wears faded cloth, shaved head, no possessions, pure, free of ill will, living on alms
meaning.hi: घुमंतू फीका वस्त्र पहनता है, मुंडा सिर, बिना परिग्रह, शुद्ध, दुर्भावना-रहित, भिक्षा पर जीता

words.sanskrit: brahma bhuyaya bhavati

meaning.en: and by this he draws closer to becoming Brahman
meaning.hi: और इससे वह ब्रह्म के निकट पहुँचता है

words.sanskrit: esha panthah parivrajakanam viradhvani va anashake va apam pravesbe va agni-pravesbe va mahaprasthane va

meaning.en: this is the path of such wanderers, whether ending on the road, by fasting, entering water, entering fire, or the great final journey
meaning.hi: यही घुमंतुओं का मार्ग है, चाहे अंत मार्ग पर, उपवास से, जल-प्रवेश से, अग्नि-प्रवेश से, या महाप्रस्थान से हो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Historical description of extreme renunciant end-of-life practice, not an instruction.

words.sanskrit: esha panthah brahmana ha anuvittah tena

meaning.en: this is the path by which Brahman is truly attained
meaning.hi: यही वह मार्ग है जिससे ब्रह्म वास्तव में पाया जाता है

words.sanskrit: sah sannyasi brahmavit iti

meaning.en: such a person is a renunciant, a knower of Brahman
meaning.hi: ऐसा व्यक्ति संन्यासी है, ब्रह्मज्ञानी

words.sanskrit: evam eva esha bhagavan iti vai yajnavalkyah

meaning.en: just this, and nothing more, revered one, said Yajnavalkya
meaning.hi: बस यही, और कुछ नहीं, हे पूजनीय, याज्ञवल्क्य ने कहा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tatra paramahamsah nama samvartaka-aruni-shvetaketu-durvasah-ribhu-nidagha-dattatreya-shuka-vamadeva-haritaka-prabhritayah

meaning.en: among renunciants are those called Paramahamsas: Samvartaka, Aruni, Shvetaketu, Durvasa, Ribhu, Nidagha, Dattatreya, Shuka, Vamadeva, Haritaka, and others
meaning.hi: संन्यासियों में परमहंस कहलाने वाले हैं: संवर्तक, अरुणि, श्वेतकेतु, दुर्वासा, ऋभु, निदाघ, दत्तात्रेय, शुक, वामदेव, हारीतक आदि

words.sanskrit: avyakta-linga avyakta-achara anunmatta unmattavat acharantah

meaning.en: their marks unclear, their conduct unclear, not actually mad though behaving as if mad
meaning.hi: उनके चिह्न अस्पष्ट, आचरण अस्पष्ट, वास्तव में पागल नहीं पर पागल जैसे आचरण करते

words.sanskrit: para-stri-pura-paranmukhah

meaning.en: turning away from another's wife or town, from every temptation
meaning.hi: किसी और की पत्नी या नगर से, हर प्रलोभन से मुँह मोड़े

words.sanskrit: tridandam kamandalum bhukta-patram jala-pavitram shikham yajnopavitam bahih antah cha

meaning.en: the triple staff, water-pot, begging bowl, water-strainer, tuft, sacred thread, both outward and inward
meaning.hi: त्रिदण्ड, कमण्डल, भिक्षा-पात्र, जल-छन्नी, शिखा, यज्ञोपवीत, बाहरी और आंतरिक दोनों

words.sanskrit: etat sarvam bhuh svaha iti apsu parityajya atmanam anvichchhet

meaning.en: letting all this go as an offering falls into water, they seek only the self
meaning.hi: इन सबको आहुति के जल में गिरने की तरह त्यागकर, वे केवल आत्मा को खोजते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yatha jata-rupa-dharah nirdvandvah nishparigrahah tattva-brahma-marge samyak-sampannah shuddha-manasah

meaning.en: established as at birth, free of opposites, without possessions, rightly settled on the path to truth, pure in mind
meaning.hi: जन्म जैसे स्थित, द्वंद्व-मुक्त, बिना परिग्रह, सत्य के मार्ग पर सही टिके, शुद्ध मन

words.sanskrit: prana-sandharana-artham yatha-ukta-kale bhaiksham acharan

meaning.en: begging only to sustain the breath, at the prescribed time
meaning.hi: केवल प्राण-रक्षा के लिए, नियत समय पर भिक्षा माँगते

words.sanskrit: udara-patrena va kara-patrena va labhalabhau samau bhutva

meaning.en: treating gain and loss alike whether eating from a hollowed palm or a single vessel
meaning.hi: लाभ-हानि समान मानते, चाहे हाथ से खाएँ या पात्र से

words.sanskrit: shunyagara-devagriha-trinakuta-valmika-vrikshamula-kulalashala-agnihotrashala-nadi-tira-giri-kuhara-kotara-kandara-nirjhara-sthandileshu aniketa-nivasah

meaning.en: dwelling without complaint in empty houses, temples, straw heaps, anthills, tree roots, sheds, riverbanks, caves, ravines, waterfalls, open ground
meaning.hi: खाली घर, मंदिर, घास-ढेर, बाँबी, वृक्ष-जड़, शाला, नदी-किनारे, गुफा, घाटी, झरने, खुली भूमि में बिना शिकायत निवास

words.sanskrit: shubha-ashubha-karma-nirmulana-parah sannyasena deha-tyagam karoti sah paramahamsah nama iti

meaning.en: devoted to uprooting both good and bad deeds, finally releasing the body through renunciation - such a one is called Paramahamsa
meaning.hi: अच्छे-बुरे दोनों कर्मों को उखाड़ने में समर्पित, संन्यास से देह-त्याग करता - ऐसा व्यक्ति परमहंस कहलाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: asha-ambarah na namaskarah na dara-putra-abhilashi

meaning.en: wearing the directions as garment, offering no salutation, free of longing for wife or children
meaning.hi: दिशाओं को वस्त्र माने, कोई नमस्कार न करे, पत्नी-संतान की लालसा से मुक्त

words.sanskrit: lakshya-alakshya-nirvartakah parivrat parameshvarah bhavati

meaning.en: treating the attainable and unattainable alike, such a wanderer becomes the highest reality
meaning.hi: पाने योग्य और न पाने योग्य को समान मानते, ऐसा घुमंतू सर्वोच्च सत्ता बन जाता है

words.sanskrit: yah bhavet purva-sannyasi tulyah vai dharmatah yadi

meaning.en: if someone has already become a renunciant equally in keeping with what is right
meaning.hi: यदि कोई पहले से समान रूप से धर्मानुसार संन्यासी बन चुका है

words.sanskrit: tasmai pranamah kartavyah na itaraya kadachana

meaning.en: reverence should be shown to that one, and to no other under any circumstance
meaning.hi: उसके प्रति श्रद्धा दिखानी चाहिए, किसी और परिस्थिति में किसी और के प्रति नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: pramadinah bahishchittah pishunah kalahotsukah

meaning.en: careless, attention wandering outward, malicious, eager for conflict
meaning.hi: लापरवाह, बाहर भटकते ध्यान वाले, द्वेषी, कलह के इच्छुक

words.sanskrit: sannyasinah api drishyante deva-sanduushita-ashayah

meaning.en: such people too are seen wearing renunciation, their intentions actually corrupted
meaning.hi: ऐसे लोग भी संन्यासी के रूप में दिखते हैं, उनके इरादे वास्तव में दूषित

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: nama-adibhyah pare bhumni svarajye chet sthitah advaythe

meaning.en: one established beyond names, settled firmly in their own sovereign reality
meaning.hi: नामों से परे, अपने सार्वभौम सत्य में दृढ़ता से स्थित

words.sanskrit: pranamet kam tada atmajnah na karyam karmana tada

meaning.en: such a self-knower need not bow to anyone, nothing remains to accomplish by that act
meaning.hi: ऐसा आत्मज्ञानी किसी को झुकने की ज़रूरत नहीं रखता, उस कर्म से कुछ पाने को शेष नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: ishvarah jiva-kalaya pravishtah bhagavan iti

meaning.en: the Lord who enters every creature through a portion of the life-force is called Bhagavan
meaning.hi: जो ईश्वर हर प्राणी में जीवन-शक्ति के अंश से प्रवेश करता है, भगवान कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: pranamet dandavat bhumau ashva-chandala-go-kharam

meaning.en: one should bow full-length to the ground before a horse, a person of lowest birth, a cow, or a donkey
meaning.hi: व्यक्ति को घोड़े, चांडाल, गाय, या गधे के सामने दण्डवत् भूमि तक झुकना चाहिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Key equal-dignity verse; frames the harsher ascetic-craving passage that follows.

words.sanskrit: mansa-panchalikayah tu yantra-loke anga-panjare

meaning.en: of this flesh-puppet, in the mechanism, in the cage of limbs
meaning.hi: इस मांस-कठपुतली का, यंत्र में, अंगों के पिंजरे में

words.sanskrit: snayu-asthi-granthi-shalinyah striyah kim iva shobhanam

meaning.en: held together by tendon, bone, and joint, what is meant to seem beautiful about women built the same way
meaning.hi: स्नायु, हड्डी, संधि से जुड़ी, इसी तरह बनी स्त्रियों में सुंदर मानने लायक क्या है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Opens the body-impermanence/anti-desire passage (1.15-1.23); translated faithfully, contextualized in commentary as a formal ascetic-genre convention aimed at the celibate reader's own craving, not a verdict on worth.

words.sanskrit: tvak-mansa-rakta-bashpa-ambu prithak kritva vilochane

meaning.en: separating in sight the skin, flesh, blood, and tears that make it up
meaning.hi: दृष्टि में त्वचा, मांस, रक्त, आँसू को अलग करके

words.sanskrit: samalokaya ramyam chet kim mudha parimuhyasi

meaning.en: look again at what seemed delightful; why fall into such needless confusion
meaning.hi: जो मनभावन लगता था उसे फिर देखो; क्यों व्यर्थ भ्रम में पड़ते हो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Part of the body-impermanence meditation; see 1.15 note.

words.sanskrit: meru-shringa-tata-ullasi ganga-jalasya upama

meaning.en: compared to the Ganga water sparkling on Mount Meru's slopes
meaning.hi: मेरु पर्वत की ढलानों पर चमकती गंगा के जल की उपमा

words.sanskrit: drishta yasmin mune mukta-harasya ullasa-shalita

meaning.en: the sage who has seen this sees the same shimmer in a strand of pearls
meaning.hi: जिस मुनि ने यह देख लिया, वह मोतियों की माला में भी वही चमक देखता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Marks the meditation's turn toward equanimity rather than revulsion.

words.sanskrit: shmashaneshu diganteshu sa eva lalana-stanah

meaning.en: that same chest, in the open ground at the edges of the cremation grounds
meaning.hi: वही वक्ष, श्मशान की सीमाओं पर खुली भूमि में

words.sanskrit: shvabhih asvadyate kale laghu-pinda iva andhasah

meaning.en: is eaten by dogs in time, like a small scrap of food casually consumed
meaning.hi: समय आने पर कुत्तों द्वारा खाया जाता है, जैसे भोजन का छोटा टुकड़ा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Cremation-ground meditation on impermanence, applies to every body without exception (cf. 1.14).

words.sanskrit: kesha-kajjala-dharinyah duhsparsha lochana-priyah

meaning.en: women with carefully kept hair and darkened eyes, delightful to see yet hard to hold
meaning.hi: सँवरे बाल और काजल वाली स्त्रियाँ, देखने में मनभावन पर थामनी कठिन

words.sanskrit: dushkrita-agnishikhah naryah dahanti trinavat naram

meaning.en: burn men like a flame lit by his own past wrongdoing, as fire consumes dry grass
meaning.hi: पुरुष के अपने पूर्व दुष्कर्म से जली आग जैसे जलाती हैं, जैसे आग सूखी घास को जलाती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Harsh ascetic-genre rhetoric; the Sanskrit itself locates the fire's origin in the man's own past wrongdoing (dushkrita), not the woman's; see commentary.

words.sanskrit: jvalanah atidure api sarasah api nirasah

meaning.en: flames that seem to burn even from a distance, and even gentle ones carry no real warmth
meaning.hi: दूर से भी जलती प्रतीत होती ज्वालाएँ, सौम्य भी बिना असली ऊष्मा के

words.sanskrit: striyah hi naraka-agninam indhanam charu darunam

meaning.en: women, in this account, become the fuel of hell's fire, appealing yet severely harmful
meaning.hi: इस वर्णन में स्त्रियाँ नरक-अग्नि का ईंधन बनती हैं, आकर्षक पर गंभीर रूप से हानिकारक

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Harshest verse in the sequence; translated faithfully and named as such in commentary rather than softened.

words.sanskrit: kama-namna kiratena vikirna mugdha-chetasah

meaning.en: by craving acting as a hunter, scattered before an already confused mind
meaning.hi: कामना नामक शिकारी द्वारा, पहले से भ्रमित मन के मार्ग में बिखेरी गई

words.sanskrit: naryah nara-vihanganam anga-bandhana-vaguraah

meaning.en: women become the snares and nets by which men, like wild birds, are trapped
meaning.hi: स्त्रियाँ वे फंदे और जाल बनती हैं जिनसे पुरुष, जंगली पक्षियों जैसे, फँसते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. The Sanskrit names kama (craving) itself as the hunter/agent; see commentary.

words.sanskrit: janma-palvala-matsyanam chitta-kardama-charinam

meaning.en: like fish born in a small stagnant pond, moving through minds thick with mud
meaning.hi: छोटे स्थिर तालाब में जन्मी मछलियों जैसे, कीचड़ भरे मनों में चलते हुए

words.sanskrit: pumsam durvasana-rajjuh nari-badisha-pindika

meaning.en: the rope is men's own poorly examined desire; women become the lure fixed to the hook
meaning.hi: रस्सी पुरुषों की अपनी ही अपरीक्षित इच्छा है; स्त्रियाँ काँटे पर लगा चारा बनती हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. durvasana (poorly examined desire) is explicitly the man's own; see commentary.

words.sanskrit: sarvesham dosha-ratnanam susamudgikaya anaya

meaning.en: by this fine casket holding every jewel-like fault
meaning.hi: हर रत्न-समान दोष को थामे इस सुंदर मंजूषा द्वारा

words.sanskrit: duhkha-shrinkhalaya nityam alam astu mama striya

meaning.en: let this chain of suffering, built from a woman's faults, be enough, be burned away
meaning.hi: स्त्री के दोषों से बनी यह दुःख की शृंखला, बस अब पर्याप्त हो, भस्म हो

words.sanskrit: namah astu mama kopaya svashraya-jvaline bhrisham

meaning.en: reverence to my own anger, blazing in its own refuge
meaning.hi: मेरे अपने क्रोध को श्रद्धा, जो अपने ही आश्रय में तीव्रता से जलता है

words.sanskrit: kopasya mama vairagya-dayine dosha-bodhine

meaning.en: which grants me detachment and wakes me to my own faults
meaning.hi: जो मुझे वैराग्य देता है और मेरे अपने दोषों के प्रति जगाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Closes the 1.15-1.23 sequence; grammatically the reverence and gratitude are directed at the speaker's own anger and self-awareness, not outward.

words.sanskrit: na pani-pada-chapalah na netra-chapalah yatih

meaning.en: the truly disciplined one shows no restlessness in hands, feet, or eyes
meaning.hi: सच्चा अनुशासित व्यक्ति हाथ, पैर, या आँखों में बेचैनी नहीं दिखाता

words.sanskrit: na cha vak-chapalah cha eva brahma-bhutah jitendriyah

meaning.en: nor restless in speech, and having become one with Brahman, has mastered the senses
meaning.hi: वाणी में भी बेचैन नहीं, और ब्रह्म से एक होकर इन्द्रियों पर विजय पा चुका

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: ripau baddhe sva-dehe cha sama-aikatmyam prapashyatah

meaning.en: one who truly sees an enemy bound to one's own body as fundamentally the same
meaning.hi: जो अपने ही शरीर से बंधे शत्रु को मूलतः एक ही मानता है

words.sanskrit: vivekinah kutah kopah sva-deha-avayaveshu iva

meaning.en: how could such a discerning person feel anger, any more than at one's own limb
meaning.hi: ऐसा विवेकशील व्यक्ति क्रोध कैसे करेगा, अपने ही अंग पर करने से अधिक नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: apakarini kope chet kope kopah katham na te

meaning.en: if anger is felt toward a wrongdoer, why is no anger felt toward anger itself
meaning.hi: यदि ग़लत करने वाले पर क्रोध आता है, तो क्रोध पर ही क्रोध क्यों नहीं आता

words.sanskrit: dharma-artha-kama-mokshanam prasahya paripanthini

meaning.en: which forcibly stands in the way of righteousness, gain, desire, and liberation
meaning.hi: जो धर्म, अर्थ, काम, और मोक्ष के मार्ग में बलपूर्वक खड़ा होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: alabhyamanah tanayah pitarau kleshayet chiram

meaning.en: a child not yet obtained causes the parents prolonged distress
meaning.hi: अप्राप्त संतान माता-पिता को लंबी पीड़ा देती है

words.sanskrit: labdhah hi garbhapatena prasavena cha badhate

meaning.en: and once conceived, brings its own burden through miscarriage-risk and childbirth
meaning.hi: और गर्भधारण होने पर, गर्भपात के जोखिम और प्रसव से अपना बोझ लाती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Numbered 1.27 in this edition; content covers the wish-for-a-child verse.

words.sanskrit: jatasya graha-rogadi kumarasya cha dhurtata

meaning.en: childhood ailments after birth, and a certain waywardness in the growing child
meaning.hi: जन्म के बाद बचपन की व्याधियाँ, और बढ़ते बालक में एक निश्चित बिगड़ैलता

words.sanskrit: upanite api avidyatvam anudvahah cha pandite

meaning.en: the risk of remaining unlearned even after formal teaching, and marriage brings no relief even for the wise
meaning.hi: औपचारिक शिक्षा के बाद भी अशिक्षित रहने का जोखिम, और विवाह विद्वान के लिए भी राहत नहीं देता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yunah cha paradaradi daridryam cha kutumbinah

meaning.en: the young man's troubles with another's household, and the poverty of the family man
meaning.hi: युवा पुरुष की पराई गृहस्थी से जुड़ी कठिनाइयाँ, और कुटुम्बी की निर्धनता

words.sanskrit: putra-duhkhasya na asti antah dhani chet mriyate tada

meaning.en: a father's sorrow over his son has no true end; even a wealthy man simply dies in time
meaning.hi: पुत्र पर पिता का शोक कभी सच में समाप्त नहीं होता; धनी व्यक्ति भी समय आने पर बस मर जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yatra suptah janah nityam prabuddhah tatra samyami

meaning.en: where ordinary people remain forever asleep, the disciplined person stays fully awake
meaning.hi: जहाँ सामान्य लोग सदा सोए रहते हैं, वहाँ अनुशासित व्यक्ति पूरी तरह जागा रहता है

words.sanskrit: prabuddhah yatra te vidwan sushuptim yati yogirat

meaning.en: and where such wise ones stay awake, the great master of yoga rests in deep, untroubled sleep
meaning.hi: और जहाँ ऐसे बुद्धिमान जागे रहते हैं, वहाँ योग का महान स्वामी गहरी, निश्चिंत निद्रा में चला जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: chit iha asti iti chit-matram idam chit-mayam eva cha

meaning.en: understanding that pure consciousness exists here, that this is nothing but consciousness, made only of consciousness
meaning.hi: यह समझते हुए कि यहाँ शुद्ध चेतना है, यह केवल चेतना है, केवल चेतना से बना

words.sanskrit: chit tvam chit aham ete cha lokah chit iti bhavaya

meaning.en: you are consciousness, I am consciousness, and these worlds too are consciousness -- meditate thus
meaning.hi: तुम चेतना हो, मैं चेतना हूँ, और ये लोक भी चेतना हैं -- ऐसा ध्यान करो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yatinam tat upadeyam parahamsyam param padam

meaning.en: for renunciants, that Paramahamsa state is the supreme destination worth reaching
meaning.hi: संन्यासियों के लिए, वह परमहंस अवस्था ही पाने योग्य परम गंतव्य है

words.sanskrit: na atah parataram kinchit vidyate muni-pungavah

meaning.en: beyond this, the great sages have declared, nothing higher exists
meaning.hi: इससे परे, महान ऋषियों ने घोषित किया, कुछ भी उच्चतर नहीं है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: chit iha asti iti chit-matram idam chit-mayam eva cha

meaning.en: meditate that consciousness exists right here, this world is nothing but consciousness
meaning.hi: ध्यान करो कि चेतना यहीं है, यह संसार केवल चेतना है

words.sanskrit: chit tvam chit aham ete cha lokah chit iti bhavaya

meaning.en: you are that consciousness, I too am that consciousness, and all these worlds are consciousness alike
meaning.hi: तुम वही चेतना हो, मैं भी वही चेतना हूँ, और ये सभी लोक समान रूप से चेतना हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Deliberate near-repetition of 1.31's teaching, addressed here in the second person.

words.sanskrit: yatinam tat upadeyam parahamsyam param padam

meaning.en: for renunciants, that same supreme state of the Paramahamsa is truly worth attaining
meaning.hi: संन्यासियों के लिए, परमहंस की वही परम अवस्था वास्तव में पाने योग्य है

words.sanskrit: na atah parataram kinchit vidyate muni-pungavah

meaning.en: beyond it, the greatest among sages have declared, nothing whatsoever remains to reach
meaning.hi: उससे परे, ऋषियों में श्रेष्ठतम ने घोषित किया, पाने को कुछ भी शेष नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Closing verse, restating 1.32 as the book's final seal.
